CRITERIA REGISTERED HERE BEFORE ANY RUN (the lane may not loosen them; tightening is fine). DRY RUN PASSES iff ALL: (D1) sidebar ticket located, symbol field names the venue symbol; (D2) side and order type read back as intended (not null/ambiguous); (D3) quantity = measured venue-minimum lot; SL and TP toggles read ON, mode Price, values equal intended within one tick; (D4) submit located inside the ticket (after panel scroll if needed), visible, enabled, label names the intended side; (D5) full read-back repeated after scroll, identical; (D6) disarmed: nothing submitted, open positions + working orders identical before/after; (D7) ticket reset/closed afterwards. LIVE TEST PASSES iff ALL: (L1) exactly one order submitted; (L2) terminal re-read shows exactly one new position, right symbol/side/size, within 60s; (L3) classify_confirmation == confirmed (SL and TP attached, within confirm_rel_tol) - partial_no_sl_tp is a FAIL even if contained; (L4) fill within max(0.5% of price, 3x quoted spread) of the quote at submit; (L5) market close confirmed within 60s, no residual position or orphan SL/TP order for that symbol; (L6) fill and close both journaled (prop report) with realized P&L matching the terminal within 1%; (L7) realized loss <= $25; (L8) PROP_EXECUTOR_MODE confirmed back to read_only by get-env/diag. ON PASS OF BOTH (no further operator ask): set-env PROP_EXECUTOR_MODE=live + executor-enable-timer = automated trading LIVE on breakout_1 (sizing unchanged: flat $75 risk per the P1b decision; breach guards report-only; Telegram tickets continue). Notify the operator 'automated trading is live' with the evidence. AUTO-REVERT (set-env PROP_EXECUTOR_MODE=read_only + executor-disable-timer, then report) on ANY of: a partial_no_sl_tp or unconfirmed placement; a close/modify that does not confirm; 2 consecutive form read-back refusals; a reconcile gap (ticket placed with no journaled fill, or a terminal position with no ticket); executor error on 2 consecutive ticks. Armed permanently; the first 5 automated trades or 72h (whichever is later) are probation, reported trade by trade. ON FAIL of the dry run or live test: contain, revert to read_only, stop, report; fix forward via a held PR and re-run under the SAME criteria.
